comments: 1fafbea0: ;Call DE to initialize variables, then go to BEGIN label

9a6e8e99: ;Initialize variables for editing^DIE call: DIE=file global root, DIC=same as DIE, DP=file #, DL=lower IEN subfile #, DIEL=0 since not editing 'multiple', DU=null, kill DG, DE, DB arrays, quit if no 0 node
648fe8ac: ;If DT node exists, set DE(1) to 5th piece which is external form of DT
3e781027: ;Kill %Z variable, then quit
e7d2c77f: ;Write prompt at column DL+DL-2, including DLB_ variable
3fd42039: ;Just quit
ce191f1f: ;Write data value Y, wrap if >45 cols from margin
40203be7: ;If Y is >19 chars and not DV type, and DV is type F or K, branch to RW^DIR2
3a45118f: ;If Y is non-null and not DV and DV is type I, and DE(DQ) exists, set X=null and print message
4c6ffc5b: ;Read X into variable X with timeout DTIME, set DTOUT=U and X=U on timeout, write *7
d56bf464: Quit
db688dfc: Increment the data queue counter DQ
514bbdf9: Branch to the line number stored in DQ
6541d4e4: If the data entry (DE) array element exists for DQ, go to the PR label, otherwise execute W and TR
e4252be0: If X is empty and DV does not contain 'R', go to A. If X is empty and DV contains 'R', go to X. If X is not empty and D is negative or zero, go to A
8ba88d47: If X starts with '?', go to QS. If X contains '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17
e4f4d019: If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2
fa4b592b: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and the DUZ user has a value in ^DISV("DIE",DLB), set X to that value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write '  ' followed by X

cf3d64d9: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to P. If the data dictionary entry at ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute it. Set % to the portion of DU after the semicolon and before the colon containing X. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and the data input code DIC("S") exists, execute it. If DB(DQ) does not exist, write '  ' followed by %. Go to V
b7e13476: If the input string Y is empty, go to the label X.
c99bc3eb: If no match is found in the input string YS, write the remaining portion starting from the position DG.
4cd0ac62: If DV contains 'P', perform a lookup using the DIC routine. If the lookup is successful (X>=0), set X to the internal entry number and DIC to DIE.
5f20d47e: If DV does not contain 'N', check if the input X is numeric. If the decimal portion of X is longer than 24 characters, set X to null and go to label Z.

9e5267d5: If the second piece of DV is non-zero, X contains a decimal point, and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) does not start with '$', format X by removing leading/trailing zeroes and converting to integer if there is no decimal portion.
80c0d498: Validate input before continuing and kill YS array.
49d652f9: Kill DIC screen and DLAYGO array, save user input in DG(DW), and save input in ^DISV for dataedit if DV contains a 'd'. Go to label A.
6c01f7d5: Write alarm and go to label Z^DIE17 if DB(DQ) is defined.
650f87d5: Set X to '?BAD' if input is invalid.
ed876a4b: Set DZ to X, execute D code, execute QQ^DIEQ, and go to label B.
801e4858: Set D to DIFLD, save field information in DQ(DQ), and quit.
8e880463: If DE(DQ) is undefined, execute O code. If X is not '@', go to RD. If X is '@' and DV does not contain 'R', go to A. If X is '@', set X to Y and go to N.
39157ea2: Set DG to DV, Y to DE(DQ), and X to DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute it and go to RP.

62858dda: If DG contains 'P' and ^(0) node exists, set X to the second piece of ^(0). If ^(Y,0) is undefined, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to first piece of ^(0), X to third piece of DD(X,.01,0), and DG to second piece of ^(0). Go to R.

c5661acf: If DG contains 'V', Y is numeric, second piece of Y contains '(', and the referenced global node exists, set X to second piece of ^(0). If ^(+Y,0) is undefined, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to first piece of ^(0). If DD(+X,.01,0) is defined, set DG to second piece of ^(0) and X to third piece of ^(0). Go to R.

2e9e6551: If input field matches the variable X, get the data from the data dictionary to insert the specified value from LAYGO references into Y. Used when setting cross-references in the Y variable.

fce7de78: RP (RE-PROCESS) label: Call the reader entry DIE0 to obtain field value if X is empty, and depending on value of DC (data committed flag) and DV (FIELDTYPE), branch to various entry points (NO RE-ENTRY, RE-ENTRY, or VALUE TOO BIG error).
417eda61: If FIELDTYPE is not WORD-PROCESSING or FREE TEXT, branch to RD (Reader) label.
6d72b00d: Call DIE0 reader, if successful set X and branch to PR (PROCESSOR), else branch to RD.
fadb190c: Exit point. Return from any recursion.
b73daf7a: Set DG array node name (DNM), and initialize the DIC(0) subscript value (DQ) to 1. Used for file global references.

05d8d0cf: Initialize DW (field global location), DV (field type), DU (input transform), DLB (field label), DIFLD (file/global field number). For DIFLD=10.05, the field is DATE SIGNED (#10.05) in file #10.
5c592aa3: ;Go to the line tag RE if it exists.
71625bb3: ;Set X to the current date/time and remove it if it's negative.
83f12f3e: ;Exit the routine.
5389a55f: ;Field 2: If DG array defined, run FileMan input transform, else set Y to UP-arrow and quit. If Y is defined, set X to Y and process input, else go to DIE17^OUT.
06c06e68: ;If date entered is before the DATE DICTATED field, display an error message, clear DATE TRANSCRIBED, and force re-entry of DATE TRANSCRIBED.
269d97b7: ;Exit the input transform.
bd649899: ;Field 3: If DG array defined, run FileMan input transform, else set Y to UP-arrow and quit. If Y is defined, set X to Y and process input, else go to DIE17^OUT.
d200916b: ;If no date entered, set TRANSCRIBED STATUS to 'TRANSCRIBED' and force re-entry of DATE TRANSCRIBED.
38b67c36: ;Exit the input transform.
b0192e35: ;Field 4: If DG array defined, run FileMan input transform, else jump to DGJXA14.
